findings.finding: G1 explains both negative-result meanings but should explicitly carry the two fictional family/test reports. Preserve all existing family-history, wider-panel and cascade-testing content.
Expand HER2 as human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 in the corrected owner definition, or bind a verified existing canonical definition.
HE2 describes copy-number outputs and the CEP17 probe, but should explicitly state the tissue nucleic-acid-probe principle. Abbott Principles of Procedure already read supports it.
Bind the shared nucleus definition for the explicit nuclear-compartment teaching. Existing nucleus and DNA records were located; their fields still need capture/readback here.
Spell out CK5/6 as cytokeratins 5 and 6 and EGFR as epidermal growth factor receptor/HER1, or bind verified existing canonical definitions. Do not imply one KRT6 isoform is the entire combined stain.
M1 separates brain parenchymal from leptomeningeal disease but should bind a verified definition of leptomeninges around the brain/spinal cord.
Make systemic therapy acting against disease too small to detect explicit; do not infer uniform exposure or eradication.

O1 names synchronous/metachronous timing without distinguishing near diagnosis from later; define limited residual/persistent disease as visible disease remaining after treatment under the author's definitions.
Name positive/negative controls in the reading card and state directly that stained-cell percentage is not treatment-benefit probability.
Retain local surgery/radiation having cure, control or symptom-relief purposes; location alone does not identify intent. The NCI palliative-care passage was read.
Bind remission's observed reduction/disappearance definition, rather than only the complete-remission definition.

The current nucleus TLDR places it at the centre of a cell as a universal statement. Use the verified membrane/chromosome definition without fixing its position. Preserve other fields at their existing scope.

Replace the blanket blood-cancer criteria and unsourced five-year proxy in the summary with the verified remission/complete-remission distinction and disease-specific assessment scope. Preserve arrays and known-care links.

scope: Coordinator definition and field-completeness findings. This does not relabel the earlier incomplete independent acceptance as complete.
